content.text:
I fixed the crash. A transform that is given an input source map without a `sourcesContent` field now finishes and produces a map, where before it threw `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading '0')`.

**Cause:** in `packages/babel-generator/src/source-map.ts`, the generator copies the original source text out of the input map with `this._inputMap.sourcesContent[i]`. `sourcesContent` is optional in source maps, so when the input map leaves it out, the trace-mapping library returns `undefined` and that line crashes. The map in your report has no `sourcesContent`, which is why it hit this.

**Fix:** one line, changing that read to `this._inputMap.sourcesContent?.[i]`. With no content to copy, the entry is just left empty.

**Check:** I rebuilt and ran `transformSync` on a short snippet with an input map that has no `sourcesContent`. It now succeeds. The output map has the right sources and mappings, with `sourcesContent: [ undefined ]` since there was no original text to carry over. I didn't run the existing test suite or add a new test.
